title: Igazi Lokuqala Elichithekileyo Ngomona
intro: Khawucinge ngemihla yokuqala yoluntu, xa lonke ihlabathi laliyintsapho enye. Ubukela njengoko iminikelo emibini ibekwa phambi koAllah - enye iyamkelwa, enye iyaliwa. Umona uyakhula entliziyweni, kwaye isoyikiso siyahletywa ngomsindo. Okulandelayo kuya kushiya uphawu kwimbali ngonaphakade, kwaye nentaka encinci iya kuba ngumfundisi.
clues: Ndinikele umnikelo kuAllah, kodwa owam awuzange wamkelwe ngelixa omnye umnikelo wawusamkelwa.
Ndenza ukubulala okungekho sikweni kokuqala emhlabeni.
Ndibone igwababa likhweba umhlaba ukuze lindibonise indlela yokufihla isidumbu.
Ndasala ndizele kukuzisola ndaza ndaba phakathi kwabantu abalahlekileyo ngenxa yoko kwenziwe zizandla zam.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Ukubulawa komntakwabo ngenxa yomona emva kokwaliwa kwesipho
Ukwakha inqaba ephakamileyo ukuze ujonge amazulu
trial.answer: Ukubulawa komntakwabo ngenxa yomona emva kokwaliwa kwesipho

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Waba nokuzisola waza waba phakathi kwabo balahlekileyo
outcome.answer: Waba nokuzisola waza waba phakathi kwabo balahlekileyo

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
